title: New York Fed Markets Data API (reference rates, SOMA, Treasury operations, primary dealers)
agency: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
questions: how much of the Treasury debt does the Federal Reserve hold, by maturity
SOFR and the effective federal funds rate over the last year, as an input to a debt-service projection
weighted average maturity of the Fed's Treasury holdings
Fed purchases of Treasury bills in recent weeks
primary dealer net positions in Treasury securities

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser and save the JSON page (File > Save as) under the name shown, then upload it. Without the links: reference rates at https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/reference-rates, SOMA holdings at https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/soma-holdings (Download), Treasury operations at https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/desk-operations/treasury, primary dealer statistics at https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/counterparties/primary-dealers-statistics.

cache.why: Rates and operations update daily, SOMA weekly; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: The Markets Data APIs are published openly by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York for public use; the Bank's terms of use allow use of its published data with attribution.

citation: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Markets Data APIs ({dataset}), markets.newyorkfed.org, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which rate: SOFR (secured, Treasury repo), EFFR (unsecured, the policy-rate benchmark) or another? Default: both, stated as separate series.
Which date for SOMA holdings: the latest weekly as-of date, or a past date for a comparison? Default: the latest (see source.md for how to find it).
